fieldflow.name: FieldFlow
fieldflow.tagline: From field photos to structured service reports.
fieldflow.title: FieldFlow — turning field service paperwork into structured workflows
fieldflow.intro: Field technicians often share photos of completed service reports through messaging apps. Coordinators then spend time interpreting, organizing and forwarding those documents by hand. FieldFlow is a proposed AI-assisted workflow that would turn those scattered photos into structured, reviewable records.

spec.audienceValue: Field service operators, maintenance teams, operations managers, coordinators

challenge.heading: Important service data gets stuck in chat threads
challenge.body: After a site visit, a technician may photograph a paper protocol and send it through a messaging app. A coordinator must identify the job, read the document, re-enter key details, check for missing information and forward it to the right recipient. The process depends on manual hand-offs and makes tracking, retrieval and consistency harder as the volume of reports grows.

solution.heading: One place to capture, review and route field reports
solution.body: FieldFlow explores a mobile-friendly submission flow and a coordinator workspace. An AI document-processing step would suggest structured fields from uploaded photos. A human reviewer would confirm or correct those fields before generating a clean report and preparing it for delivery. The design keeps people in control of final approval.

steps.title: Capture
steps.body: A technician uploads one or more photos of a completed service protocol.

steps.title: Extract
steps.body: AI-assisted processing proposes key fields such as job reference, date, customer, work performed and notes.

steps.title: Review
steps.body: A coordinator checks the source image alongside the extracted information and corrects anything uncertain.

steps.title: Prepare & send
steps.body: Once approved, the workflow prepares a standardized PDF or structured export for authorized delivery.

value.heading: Designed to reduce repetitive coordination work
items: Less manual transcription and repetitive forwarding.
More consistent report structure and easier retrieval.
Better visibility into outstanding or incomplete reports.
value.disclaimer: These are expected benefits of the proposed workflow, not validated results. No performance measurements are available yet.

principles.heading: Practical automation with human oversight
items: Mobile-first submission for technicians in the field.
Explicit human validation before external delivery.
Visibility into missing or low-confidence information.
Traceability from the original image to the final report.
Data protection and access controls as requirements for any future implementation.

nextSteps.heading: A concept today, a potential MVP next
nextSteps.body: FieldFlow is currently a solution concept. A future proof-of-concept implementation could validate document extraction accuracy, review time and coordinator usability using synthetic or properly authorized sample documents. No production deployment or customer results are claimed.

closing.heading: Have a similar manual workflow in your business?
